description:
targetRepsMax exists on program_exercise and drives nothing. Double progression is the rule it was modelled for: when the top of the rep range is hit across all target sets, the weight goes up and the reps reset to the bottom of the range.

Suggest, do not apply. A deterministic rule over data already held, with no model anywhere near it. Warm-up sets must be excluded from the judgement, which the records module already knows how to do.
title: Suggest the next weight from double progression
